level1.text: A runner moves at a uniform velocity along a straight track a distance of $120\,\text{m}$ in $15\,\text{s}$ in the direction chosen as positive. What is the runner's velocity?
A cart on the $x$-axis is first at the position $12\,\text{m}$ and then moves to the position $-5.0\,\text{m}$. What is the displacement of the cart? Give the answer with its sign.
A cart moves at a uniform velocity of $3.5\,\text{m/s}$ in the positive direction for $12\,\text{s}$. How large is the displacement of the cart?
The $(t, x)$ graph of a cart is a straight line that passes through the points $(0\,\text{s};\, 4.0\,\text{m})$ and $(10\,\text{s};\, 24\,\text{m})$. What is the velocity of the cart?

At the moment $t = 0\,\text{s}$ a walker is at the position $15\,\text{m}$ and walks uniformly at a velocity $1.5\,\text{m/s}$ in the positive direction. At what position is she at the moment $t = 20\,\text{s}$?

level2.text: A car drives along a straight road at a uniform velocity $90\,\text{km/h}$. How long a distance does it travel in $12\,\text{s}$? Give the answer in metres.
A runner moves along a straight path at a uniform velocity of $4.0\,\text{m/s}$. How many minutes does it take her to cover a distance of $1.2\,\text{km}$?

At the moment $t = 2.0\,\text{s}$ a cart is at the position $18\,\text{m}$ and at the moment $t = 7.0\,\text{s}$ at the position $3.0\,\text{m}$. The cart moves uniformly. Calculate the velocity of the cart with its sign.

At the moment $t = 0\,\text{s}$ a cart is at the position $-24\,\text{m}$ and moves uniformly at a velocity $1.5\,\text{m/s}$ in the positive direction. When is the cart at the origin, that is at the position $x = 0$?

level3.text: A cyclist rides along a straight road east $6.0\,\text{km}$ in $20\,\text{min}$ and then turns straight back, riding the same $6.0\,\text{km}$ west in $30\,\text{min}$. Calculate the average speed over the whole trip, that is the distance travelled divided by the elapsed time. Give the answer in the unit m/s.

Aino and Eeva start walking towards each other at the same time along the same line. Aino starts from the position 0 and walks at a velocity $1.5\,\text{m/s}$ in the positive direction. Eeva starts from the position $90\,\text{m}$ and walks at a velocity $-1.2\,\text{m/s}$. At what position do they meet?

The $(t, x)$ graph of a robot consists of three straight parts: between 0 and $10\,\text{s}$ the position grows from 0 to $30\,\text{m}$, between 10 and $20\,\text{s}$ the robot is at rest and between 20 and $40\,\text{s}$ the position decreases to $10\,\text{m}$. What is the average velocity of the robot over the whole $40\,\text{s}$? Give the answer with its sign.
